title: Breakfast ideas (staples)
note: Names and one line only. 'needs' are staples matched against the pantry; breakfasts are ranked by variety and taste more than by pantry fit.

ideas.name: Fried egg over rice
ideas.line: Runny yolk, soy sauce, scallion if there is some.

ideas.name: Oatmeal with fruit
ideas.line: Warm oats, sliced fruit, a little honey.

ideas.name: Cheese omelette
ideas.line: Two eggs, a handful of cheddar.

ideas.name: Peanut butter toast
ideas.line: Peanut butter and banana or apple slices.

ideas.name: Rice porridge (congee)
ideas.line: Leftover rice simmered soft, egg and soy.

ideas.name: French toast
ideas.line: Bread dipped in egg and milk, pan-fried.

ideas.name: Pancakes
ideas.line: Flour, egg, milk; fruit or Nutella on top.

ideas.name: Egg and cheese quesadilla
ideas.line: Scrambled egg and cheddar in a tortilla.
